```{r}
run_dir <- Sys.getenv("HERBIVORE_PORTAL_RUN_DIR", unset = "")
if (!nzchar(run_dir)) {
  run_dir <- "."
}

read_safe <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  utils::read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

run_index <- read_safe(file.path(run_dir, "run_index.csv"))
daily_summary <- read_safe(file.path(run_dir, "tables", "daily_summary.csv"))
endpoint_summary <- read_safe(file.path(run_dir, "tables", "endpoint_summary.csv"))
domain_sanity <- read_safe(file.path(run_dir, "tables", "domain_sanity_summary.csv"))

sens_design <- read_safe(file.path(run_dir, "tables", "sensitivity_design.csv"))
sens_endpoint <- read_safe(file.path(run_dir, "tables", "sensitivity_endpoint_summary.csv"))
sens_sanity <- read_safe(file.path(run_dir, "tables", "sensitivity_domain_sanity_summary.csv"))
acceptance_single <- read_safe(file.path(run_dir, "tables", "ecological_acceptance_summary.csv"))
acceptance_sens <- read_safe(file.path(run_dir, "tables", "sensitivity_ecological_acceptance_summary.csv"))

figure_files <- list.files(file.path(run_dir, "figures"), pattern = "[.]png$", full.names = TRUE)
```

## Run Overview

- Run directory: `r normalizePath(run_dir, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)`
- Generated at: `r format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")`

```{r}
if (!is.null(run_index)) {
  knitr::kable(run_index, digits = 3, caption = "Run index")
} else {
  cat("Run index file not found.")
}
```

## Daily Trajectories (Single-Run Mode)

```{r}
if (!is.null(daily_summary)) {
  knitr::kable(utils::head(daily_summary, 12), digits = 3, caption = "Daily summary (first 12 rows)")
} else {
  cat("No single-run daily summary detected. If this was a sensitivity run, see next sections.")
}
```

```{r}
if (!is.null(endpoint_summary)) {
  knitr::kable(endpoint_summary, digits = 3, caption = "Single-run endpoint summary")
}
```

```{r}
if (!is.null(domain_sanity)) {
  knitr::kable(domain_sanity, digits = 3, caption = "Domain sanity summary")
}
```

## Sensitivity Results

```{r}
if (!is.null(sens_design)) {
  knitr::kable(sens_design, digits = 3, caption = "Sensitivity design table")
} else {
  cat("No sensitivity design table found for this run.")
}
```

```{r}
if (!is.null(sens_endpoint)) {
  knitr::kable(sens_endpoint, digits = 3, caption = "Sensitivity endpoint summary")
}
```

```{r}
if (!is.null(sens_sanity)) {
  knitr::kable(sens_sanity, digits = 3, caption = "Sensitivity domain sanity summary")
}
```

## Ecological Acceptance Checks

```{r}
if (!is.null(acceptance_single)) {
  knitr::kable(acceptance_single, digits = 3, caption = "Single-run ecological acceptance checks")
} else if (!is.null(acceptance_sens)) {
  knitr::kable(acceptance_sens, digits = 3, caption = "Sensitivity ecological acceptance checks")
} else {
  cat("No ecological acceptance table was found for this run.")
}
```

## Figures

```{r}
if (length(figure_files) < 1L) {
  cat("No figures were found in this run.")
} else {
  for (p in figure_files) {
    cat("###", basename(p), "\n\n")
    knitr::include_graphics(p)
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```

## Interpretation Guardrails

- Treat unsupported hypotheses as explicit non-findings rather than failures.
- Use the domain sanity tables to confirm no numerical/pathological behavior before interpretation.
- For publication or sharing, preserve this report together with `run_index.csv` and `portal_run_manifest.json`.
